plan.selection: Exclude iff native best_ask is absent at fixed t0; no outcome-based exclusions.
plan.budget: 40 seeds; end_time=50000; 4 independent worker processes. Default study retains 50000 to measure [45000,50000]; model parameters and horizon unchanged from the single-seed run. Eligibility leaves 39/40 candidates.

eligibility.criterion: Exclude iff native best_ask is absent at fixed t0; no outcome-based exclusions.
eligibility.estimand: Mean impact conditional on a background best_ask existing at t0.
eligibility.timing: Criterion adopted after liquidity diagnosis, before this ensemble rerun.

statistics.sd: Sample standard deviation across seeds (ddof=1); not a confidence interval.
statistics.ci: Pointwise 95% percentile bootstrap CI of the seed mean; resample whole seed trajectories with fixed common weights across time; not a simultaneous band.
statistics.tail_ci: Bootstrap of the per-seed time averages; no assumption of independent timestamps.
statistics.missing: Report a grid point only if all seeds have a mid. Require full post-t0 coverage; never zero-fill or discard seeds.
statistics.mid: Last pre-acceptance quote snapshot at each timestamp, previous-value hold; lobcore one-sided fallback; no future backfill.
statistics.window: Unit-spaced integer grid, exact step-function integral on [start,end); endpoint at end has zero time weight.
statistics.scope: Monte Carlo uncertainty for this fixed model/configuration; [45000,50000] is a finite-horizon proxy, not proof of an infinite-time limit.
